protocol.method: actual upstream GEPA core with custom adapter and externally executed reflection/writing/quality/Chrome evaluation callbacks
protocol.search_split: same single reused case in trainset and valset; neither is held out
protocol.target_utility: 1 - GPTZero AI confidence/100 if independent factual review passes and readability is not worse than incumbent; quality rejection utility=-1 without detector scan
protocol.candidate_publication: none unless separate requested publication requirements met; no public reply is part of this experiment
protocol.prompt_scope: Only frozen SKILL.md Write and review section may change; all other bytes and referenced resources remain fixed
protocol.writers: fresh isolated agent per new policy, same inherited model/settings when exposed; no detector scores or method history
protocol.reflection: full development feedback including archived failures and current loop outcomes; never holdout contents
protocol.quality: separate agent checks exact full/prose bytes and claims, scores withheld; reject factual or readability regression before scans
protocol.cache: reuse exact candidate/case output and validated native receipt for GEPA parent reevaluations; these are cache hits, not fresh scans
protocol.confirmation: if best positive search gain, freeze policy then compare freshly generated incumbent/candidate on two preselected independent cases; quality non-regression and at least 5 mean percentage-point gain, no per-case detector regression; otherwise do not promote
limitations: agent-driven external workers, not autonomous browser execution

writer_packet_amendment.stage: before baseline output and any scan
writer_packet_amendment.reason: First fresh writer followed ordinary phrase-review reference and found archived target detector results. No output written; writer discarded.
writer_packet_amendment.writer_packet: Both arms receive complete frozen SKILL.md plus identical phrase-review ordinary-editing view ending before Applicability section. Measurement/research references are not exposed to output writers.
writer_packet_amendment.unchanged_source: Complete18-file incumbent remains frozen. This affects role packets for both arms, not optimized text.

operator_audit.description: Baseline and candidate 1 were both fresh isolated writers with the same case, skill wrapper, ordinary phrase reference, factual requirements, word limit and inherited settings. The coordinator dispatch wording was not byte-identical: candidate 1 expanded artifact metadata instructions and used different phrasing for scope restrictions. Exact operators are retained. Treat this as a bundled pilot, not an isolated causal policy comparison.
operator_audit.future_dispatch: Use recovered baseline operator with only skill/output paths substituted for candidate 2 and any common confirmation pair.
operator_audit.model_and_sampling_details: Inherited by fresh agents; exact backend identifiers and sampling settings are unexposed. No model override used.
